world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
world_org_meetings.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

world_org_meetings.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
world_org_meetings.description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

world_org_meetings.title: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

diplomatic_visits.title: Zelensky rallies European allies as Trump ties slump
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky is seeking to rally European allies at a Brussels summit on Friday after saying Kyiv would no longer abide by US President Donald Trump's demands not to strike Russian oil refineries. Relations between Kyiv and Washington have soured since last week, when Trump eased sanctions on Russia in exchange for Moscow releasing large amounts of diesel onto global markets.

diplomatic_visits.title: Live: ‘This is no time to withdraw’ support for Ukraine, EU’s Costa says
diplomatic_visits.description: EU Council President Antonio Costa on Friday warned against withdrawing support from Ukraine, maintaining that it was time instead to step up the pressure on Russia. His remarks came ahead of a summit of EU leaders in Brussels joined by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

diplomatic_visits.title: Kazakhstan seeks Antwerp-Bruges partnership to boost trade via Middle Corridor
diplomatic_visits.description: Kazakhstan is seeking closer cooperation with Belgium on the Middle Corridor, including a potential partnership between the Port of Antwerp-Bruges and the Caspian ports of Aktau and Kuryk, as King Philippe and Queen Mathilde make their first state visit to the country.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta crowds affirm Spanish identity during royal visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia received a rapturous welcome in Ceuta on Tuesday, 13 October, as they began their first visit to the Spanish North African territory since 2007.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles praises Welsh 'sense of belonging' as he opens Senedd
diplomatic_visits.description: The monarch and Queen Camilla officially open the Senedd's seventh term on their visit to Cardiff.

elections.title: Are student protests being manipulated ahead of France's presidential election?
elections.description: France's prime minister has suggested that student anger is being weaponised, as the unions and other protesters prepare to take to the streets too.

elections.title: How high inflation is hurting Trump's Republicans in U.S. midterm campaign
elections.description: For nearly a year, U.S. President Donald Trump has been trying to persuade voters not to get riled up over rising prices, but polls suggest voters aren't buying his sales pitch, with respondents giving him low marks on the cost of living and disapproving of how he's handled inflation.

elections.title: Prime Minister Mark Carney says US is trying to break Canada as Alberta votes on separation path
elections.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has campaigned for national unity as advance voting is underway in oil-rich Alberta in a referendum that could set the province on a path toward a future vote on separation from Canada

elections.title: Brazil's elections matter for the planet. This is why
elections.description: Brazil is heading back to the polls, but the impact could be felt worldwide. With the Amazon vital to the health of the planet, the election could help shape its future.

elections.title: Indian authorities heighten security, close park ahead of 'cockroach' movement rally
elections.description: Authorities have closed a central park in the Indian capital ahead of the latest protest by the youth-led "Cockroach Janta Party". The group has held near-daily demonstrations calling for the national election authority chief's resignation over the removal of more than 130 million people from voter lists.
